description: Freight Data is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. This page contains freight forecasts and associated documentation from the Strategic Freight Model 2022. This includes: The Excel flat file for the Strategic Freight Model 2022, known as SFM22. This contains NSW freight commodity volume movement forecasts for the 40 year period from 2021 to 2061. Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are Freight, NSW Freight, TPA, forecast, nsw. It offers 14 resource(s) in DOCX, XLSX. The portal shows 2025-06-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
